transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I guess what finally got me to come in is that work is starting to get pretty messed up. I'm an electrician, and lately, I just can't keep my focus on one estimate or code form anymore. 

It's like... I'll sit down to look at the paperwork, and a tool noise in the background, or a text message, or just some new idea I get about reorganizing the workshop completely pulls me off track. I just drop what I'm doing and move on to the next thing. Because of that, my jobs are starting to get mixed up, and I really can't afford to keep making mistakes like that.
How long has this difficulty with focus and concentration been going on? Is this something new that's started recently, or have you struggled with staying on task for most of your life?

It's definitely a newer thing. I've always been pretty good at keeping my head down and getting the work done. 

I'd say... well, it's been building up for about seven months now. That was right around the time we took on the mortgage for the workshop and bought all the new equipment. So, yeah, about seven months of it just getting harder and harder to stay on track.
When this mortgage and equipment purchase happened seven months ago, did you also notice any increase in worry, stress, or feeling overwhelmed around that time?

No, not really. I mean, sure, it was a big purchase, but I wasn't really worried about it. If anything, I was actually pretty excited to get the new gear and expand the business. I haven't been feeling stressed or overwhelmed or anything like that. Just... easily distracted, like I said.

Have you had any recent illnesses, head injuries, or changes in your health around the time this started seven months ago? Also, have you started taking any new medications or supplements, or changed how much coffee, energy drinks, or anything else like that you consume?

No, nothing like that. I haven't been sick, and I definitely haven't hit my head or had any accidents on the job. My health has been fine. 

As for medications, no, I don't take anything. I haven't started any new supplements either. And with caffeine... I mean, I drink coffee in the morning like I always have, maybe a cup or two, but I haven't started drinking more of it or getting into those energy drinks or anything. Everything in that department has pretty much stayed the same.

Have you experienced any other new symptoms over these past seven months besides the difficulty concentrating—such as headaches, dizziness, memory problems, mood changes, sleep changes, or anything else that feels different from your normal self?

Well, no headaches or dizziness or anything like that. My memory is fine. But, uh, sleep... yeah, my sleep has definitely changed. 

For months now, I've only been getting maybe three or four hours a night. The thing is, I'm not tired. I just pop up way before dawn, and I feel completely ready to go, like I had a full night's rest. I'll just get right to work—pricing out materials, answering emails, sketching out another electrical system for a job... I just haven't really needed much sleep lately.

During these past seven months when you've been needing less sleep and feeling energized, have you noticed any changes in your mood or how you feel about yourself? For instance, do you feel more confident, more energetic, or like you're capable of doing more than usual?

Yeah, actually, I have. I definitely feel a lot more confident. I keep feeling like... like I can take on big commercial jobs and just train a whole crew right now. I mean, part of me knows my licensing and experience aren't exactly where they need to be for all that yet, but I just feel so capable lately, like I could handle it all without a problem.

During these months when you've been feeling so energetic and confident, have you experienced anything unusual—like hearing voices or sounds that others don't hear, or seeing things that others don't see?

No, nothing like that. I haven't heard any voices or seen anything that isn't there. It's just been the energy and feeling like I can take on the world, really. But no, no hallucinations or anything weird like that.

During these past seven months with all this energy and confidence, have you had to take time off work, or has anyone expressed serious concern about your behavior or judgment? Have things gotten so out of hand that you needed to see a doctor or go to the hospital?

Well, I haven't had to go to the hospital or anything like that. But... things have definitely gotten a bit messy at work. 

I haven't taken time off, but my clients have started complaining lately. I guess I've been missing some details on jobs, and my scheduling has gotten all mixed up. And my apprentices... they just don't seem to trust my direction the way they used to. 

And at home, it's been pretty rough. My wife and I are constantly arguing about the mortgage and the business. She feels like I'm putting everything we've built at risk with how I've been acting. So, yeah, people are definitely concerned.

Before these past seven months, have you ever had a period—even just a few days or a week—where you needed very little sleep, felt full of energy, and were racing from one project or idea to the next?

No, I don't think so. I mean, not that I can remember. Before this started about seven months ago, I was just... normal, I guess. I'd get tired, sleep regular hours, work my normal shifts. I've never had a time where I was just running on empty and feeling this wired before. This is the first time it's been like this.

During these past seven months when you've been feeling so energetic and confident, have you made any big financial decisions, started new business ventures, or done anything risky or impulsive that you wouldn't normally do?

No, I haven't done anything like that. I mean, I haven't started any new businesses or made any huge financial decisions. 

I know I mentioned earlier that my wife is worried about the mortgage and the business, but that's really just because I've been messing up the scheduling and frustrating my clients, which obviously hurts our income. It's not like I went out and bought a new fleet of work trucks or emptied our savings account or anything. I'm just doing my regular electrical jobs, just... I guess trying to do too much at once. So, no, nothing super risky or impulsive like that.

During these seven months when you've been feeling so confident and energetic, have you had any beliefs about yourself—like feeling you have special powers or abilities, or that people are paying special attention to you—that seemed very real at the time, even if you're not sure about them now?

No, nothing like that. I mean... I don't think I have any special powers or anything. I just feel really capable, you know? Like I have a ton of energy to get my jobs done. 

But I definitely don't think I'm superhuman, and I haven't felt like people are paying special attention to me or anything weird. I've just been feeling really confident in myself. So, no, no special abilities.
